summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: npm package frontend-orb@4.4.15 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases and then uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled file `math_init.js` on the installer's host. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI Orb (CI configuration tooling) and has no functional need for a second language runtime or a compiled opaque payload; `math_init.js` is unrelated to any orb functionality and uses string-array rotation with hex-named identifiers (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`). The declared `main: index.js` is absent from the tarball, so the package's only effect on install is fetching the Bun runtime and running the obfuscated blob under it. Package metadata (author `christopher@ornikar.com`, repo `ornikar/frontend-orb`) presents the package as internal Ornikar tooling, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
